name: Steel Wake
description:
About This Game

One-Mech-Army

In Steel Wake, you besiege an entire fortification by yourself in a mech densely packed with weapons and armors. Trample through enemy defenses and bring destruction with your excessive firepower. 

Unstoppable

You're piloting a heavily armored siege mech. Shrug off whatever hits you with thick frontal armors. You can walk through almost anything in the way. 

Customize Loadout

Arm yourself up with heavy weapons of your choice. Bring chunky cannon shells, cloud of missiles, raining artilleries to battle. Expand your armory for diverse array of armaments. 

Plan Your Approach

Efficiently dismantle enemy defenses with your tactics and knowledge. Route your way to take advantages. Cut their supplies and hit their weaknesses. Cripple their ability to fight back.

Dusty World of Machines

Explore dust-coated world of derelict ruins. Collect powerful, intricate mechanical weaponries. Discover crumbs of humanity in a dead world.
short_desc: Steel Wake is a rogue-lite mech FPS takes place in a future locked in a perpetual war. Pilot a siege mech capable of large-scale destruction. Push through enemy defenses and cause havoc with overwhelming firepower.
